description: This PHP class 'LeaveConfigurationService' extends 'ConfigService' and manages leave-related configuration settings such as entitlement consumption strategy, work schedule implementation, leave period status, and whether leave period is defined. It provides getter and setter methods for these configurations.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class for managing leave configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the leave entitlement consumption algorithm setting.

methods.name: getWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Retrieves the work schedule implementation setting for leave.

methods.name: includePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Determines if pending leave should be included in leave balance.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period status.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Sets whether the leave period has been defined.

methods.name: isLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the leave period has been set.
